# Orderkross från ABB: ”Jobbar i väldigt starka marknader”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-07-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Interview with ABB CEO Morten Wierod after a strong quarterly report: 14% revenue growth, orders up 30% to a record above USD 12bn, and guidance raised. The discussion covered strong electrification and data-center demand through 2030, an order dip in automation, and ABB's USD 5.5bn bid for UK actuator maker Rotork at a 60% premium. The tone was clearly positive, apart from a one-off legal cost of about 1bn.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Record orders, USD 30bn backlog, raised guidance, and data-center demand the CEO calls strong through 2030; the host congratulates ABB on a 'fantastic report'.

#### Reasoning

The view comes from the CEO (management), not an independent analyst. Orders grew 30%, well above estimates. New factory capacity lets ABB turn its record backlog into revenue, and guidance was raised. Data centers are the 'sweet spot', with hyperscaler capex plans raised for 2027-28. Rotork broadens automation and adds to EPS from year 2. Risks: weaker automation orders, a USD 5.5bn deal at a 60% premium, and one-off costs. No explicit buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex is cut or fears of AI overinvestment grow
- if automation orders keep falling
- if Rotork integration costs rise or the deal fails
- if one-off costs recur

> *"Vi är fortfarande väldigt optimistiska när vi ser på tillväxten inför datacenter. Vi är tidigt i början av AI-bögen."*
